title: A delivery opened before a rename is received under the new number
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • A second browser tab is open on the same site, signed in as the same Admin at {Location-A}.
  • Part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-RECV-01) is stocked at {Location-A} with 3 on hand.
  • Vendor {Vendor-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL RECV Vendor) exists.
  • Purchase order {Purchase-order-A} (for example PO-1011) has a line for {Part-A}, picked from the lookup, with 2 ordered and none received.
  • Purchase order {Purchase-order-B} (for example PO-1012) has a line where {Part-A} was typed by hand and added as typed, with 1 ordered and none received.
  • The new number, {Number-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-RECVNEW-02), is unused and does not contain {Part-A}.
  • The invoice numbers you will type are {Invoice-A} (for example ZZ-RECV-INV-1) and {Invoice-B} (for example ZZ-RECV-INV-2).
custom_steps:
1. In tab 1, go to Parts → Purchase Orders and open {Purchase-order-A}.
  2. In tab 1, click Receive.
  3. Leave the Receive screen open in tab 1. Do not submit it yet.
  4. In tab 2, go to Parts → Inventory and type {Part-A} in the search.
  5. In tab 2, click the {Part-A} row.
  6. In tab 2, replace the Part Number with {Number-A}.
  7. In tab 2, click Save.
  8. In tab 1, fill the invoice number {Invoice-A}, a cost (for example 10.00), a sell price (for example 20.00) and a received quantity of 2.
  9. In tab 1, click Receive.
  10. In tab 2, go to Parts → Inventory and type {Number-A} in the search.
  11. In tab 2, go to Parts → Part Library and type {Part-A} in the search.
  12. In tab 2, go to Parts → Vendor Invoices and open {Invoice-A}.
  13. In tab 2, go to Parts → Purchase Orders and open {Purchase-order-B}.
  14. In tab 2, click Receive.
  15. Fill the invoice number {Invoice-B}, a cost (for example 10.00), a sell price (for example 20.00) and a received quantity of 1.
  16. Click Receive.
  17. Go to Parts → Vendor Invoices and open {Invoice-B}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 7: the rename is saved.
  • Step 9: the delivery is accepted.
  • Step 10: {Number-A} shows 3 + 2 = 5 on hand.
  • Step 11: no Part Library entry has the old number {Part-A}: the receipt made none.
  • Step 12: the invoice line reads {Number-A}, even though the Receive screen was opened before the rename.
  • Step 17: the hand-typed line was received under its own number: the invoice line reads {Part-A}.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S13-R19c, S13-R19a, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas: no board shows this behaviour (13 Oct copy). Tech plan §3 D30. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R19c: “For a line linked to the renamed part, accepting a delivery uses the part's current number, even when the Receive screen was opened before the rename. No Part Library entry is created for the old number. A hand-typed line (S13-R19a) is received under its own number.”
  • S13-R19a: “A line that only shares the old number, typed in by hand with no link to this part, keeps its number.”
  • Tech plan, 7 Oct 2026, §3 D30: “for a line linked to an order item with a `part_id`, the handler resolves the number from that part's current entry instead, so a rename between opening and accepting is honored and no entry is created for the old number.”
